At 3 hover-induced velocities, momentum theory and the NASA planar projection give 10.020749R from vertical 1.1R; the local factor stays 0.88781836. No measured X-Cell power error follows.

The X-Cell sets the empirical instability gain to zero. At normalized descent −1.5 the baseline gives 2.0 and the experimental gain-one variant gives 2.75. The small baseline splice still exists with zero gain.

Manufacturer F50 2150KV/F5146 at 5,436 and 10,238 rpm reports 38 and 152 g. Substitution of the stock kT into T=kTΩ² gives +34.55076% and +19.31568% at those rows. These are static row errors at known RPM.

The actual bounce changes the body yaw rate while leaving relative shafts untouched. Adding Σ(JΩ²/2−sJΩωz) to locked-body energy reverses the archived sign from −0.0064924 to +0.0107881 J. Setting all shaft speeds to zero restores dissipation. The fixture calls the stock response at a constructed state.

The swept geometry uses the candidate endpoint's 300 rad/s shaft gate. During a 0.10–0.30 tick overlap, a rising shaft stays below threshold and passes it afterward; the falling witness does the reverse. Disagreement is relative to event-time semantics.

At a fixed own shaft speed, health and hub state, the direct thrust and torque expressions receive neither terrain clearance nor neighbor flow. Rigid-body and shared-bus coupling still operate. The installed thrust-loss percentage is unmeasured.

Representation of a constant wind should not alter local propeller air. In the gas branch only the spatial provider supplies the hub velocity correction. On the P-51, (0,2,0) × (0.720785,0,−0.070776) gives (−0.141552,0,−1.441570) m/s; zero rotation removes the force discrepancy.

The loader stores the engine's indicated idle intercept. The running shaft returns torque after friction and the fuel law uses delivered power. Their idle-reference difference is ΩQfriction, 102.039 and 122.915 W for the two named installations. Corrected fuel magnitude still needs calibration.

Sub-1-rpm table evaluations return zero; negative axial speed is clamped before advance-ratio lookup. The separate stopped finite-glow blade calculation has signed force and torque. No general propeller stall or restart assertion follows.

The turbine uses RPM to index static fuel and thrust. At 110,000 rpm the opposite commands share 0.002459 kg/s and 32.20092 N, while spool rates have opposite signs. Transient engine fuel/exhaust data are missing.
